_comment: Hand-curation layer, keyed by project id. Any field here overrides the generated value and survives every refresh. Use it to rename, hide, feature, reorder, fix a misclassified type/link/category, or rewrite description/benefit. Items omitted here use fully auto-generated values. `category` groups the Work list (app, ios-app, game, learning, automation, utility) — set it explicitly here so it survives every refresh.
